```{r}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
```

## Widgets

Check the spacing above the widget.

```{r}
#| echo: false
path1 <- tempfile()
writeLines(letters, path1)
path2 <- tempfile()
writeLines(letters[-(10:11)], path2)

diffviewer::visual_diff(path1, path2)
```

Check the spacing below the widget.
